note: FICTIONAL advertisers with deliberately visual identities (colour, product shape). Brand names are labels for the atlas only and are NOT placed in prompts, so the model cannot draw on any real company that happens to share a name. Names were coined for this demo and have not been checked against trademark registers. Each advertiser prompt is the shared scene text plus that advertiser's private visual brief; the negative (unconditional) prompt is shared. Bids never enter prompts.
negative_prompt: text, letters, words, watermark, signature, real brand logo, blurry, lowres, deformed, cropped
